power.answer: Lufthansa carries up to two power banks per passenger in cabin baggage only, each up to 100 Wh (2 g lithium content). They may not be used or charged on board except for approved medical devices, and may not go in the overhead locker. One model, the Mobikins MK-PB-04, is banned on all Lufthansa Group flights.

faq: Can I charge my phone from a power bank on Lufthansa?
No. Lufthansa prohibits charging and using power banks on board, apart from approved medical devices.
How do I get approval for a 150 Wh power bank on Lufthansa?
Register it through the Lufthansa Help Center when you book. Without approval only banks up to 100 Wh are accepted.
Can a medication cooling bag run off a power bank on Lufthansa?
No. Lufthansa says cooling bags are not medical devices, so they must run on built-in batteries or cooling packs.
